description:
‘Hee-won’, born a natural-born silver spoon and alpha male, had been living a life of debauchery that was the envy of all.
Escaping the watchful eye of his father, who wanted him to take over the family business, he fled to a remote village,
where he met a handsome young man named ‘Lee-ji’.

Contrary to Heewon’s expectations of seducing Lee Ji for a night of passion, Lee Ji brings him dog food and a collar himself, introducing himself as the ‘director of a dogfighting training centre’...

*“I thought you were some kind of mongrel, but you’re just a dog in heat, aren’t you?”*
